title: The World Population: Distribution, Density and Growth

topics.title: Patterns of population distribution and density
topics.ncert_sections: Patterns of Population Distribution in the World; Density of Population

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the uneven distribution of the world's population across its land area.
Calculate and interpret the density of population as persons per sq km.

topics.title: Factors influencing the distribution of population
topics.ncert_sections: Factors Influencing the Distribution of Population

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how water, landforms, climate and soils affect where people live.
Explain how minerals, urbanisation and industrialisation concentrate population.
Recognise how religious, cultural, political and government factors influence settlement.

topics.title: Population growth: basic concepts
topics.ncert_sections: Population Growth; Some Basic Concepts of Population Geography

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish growth of population in absolute numbers from the growth rate in per cent.
Compute natural growth and actual growth of population from births, deaths and migration.
Explain the conditions that produce positive or negative growth of population.

topics.title: Components of population change: births and deaths

concepts.learning_objective: Define and calculate the crude birth rate per thousand of population.
Define and calculate the crude death rate and relate falling mortality to population growth.

topics.title: Migration: origin, destination, push and pull factors

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish immigrants from emigrants and the place of origin from the place of destination.
Classify the push and pull factors that influence migration.
Describe fertility, mortality and population growth in the three stages of demographic transition.
Identify family planning and other measures that help control population growth.
State Malthus's theory on population growth and food supply.
